metadata.description: Granblue Fantasy: Relink Standard Edition Content • Granblue Fantasy: Relink Game • Granblue Special Item Set: Relink Pack* *The Granblue Special Item Set: Relink Pack contains the following items that can be used in the browser/mobile game, Granblue Fantasy: 1. Main Character Outfit: Rebelwear x 1 2. Eternals' Transcendence Set or Evokers' Domain Set To receive the items from the Granblue Special Item Set: Relink Pack, it must be purchased by 11:59 p.m., May 31, 2024 (Local). This pack originally had a redemption deadline of 6:59 a.m. on December 31, 2024 (PT), but it has since been extended to be redeemable after 2025. A Granblue Fantasy account is required to receive these items. For more information, please refer to the Granblue Fantasy: Relink official site (https://relink.granbluefantasy.jp/en/products/?download-ps). (Updated Dec 20, 2024) The disc PS4™ game can be upgraded to the digital PS5™ version at no additional cost. You will need to keep the PS4™ disc inserted in order to play the digital PS5™ version of the game. A PlayStation®5 Console is required to upgrade the PS4™ game on disc to the digital PS5™ version. Additionally, the digital PS4™ version of the game can be upgraded to the digital PS5™ version at no additional cost. The digital edition of the game contains both the PS4™ and PS5™ versions of the game (the main game on the PlayStation™Store and additional downloadable content). Some content may be inaccessible without an internet connection. Online multiplayer requires a PlayStation®Plus subscription. 3D audio requires built-in TV speakers or analog/USB stereo headphones.
